problem: State System needs to move from a reference design and CLI artifact set into a user-testable, agent-operated substrate. Humans should not be direct state operators; they should test and judge through agent activations and reporting surfaces, while apps consume explicit state-system contracts.
stakeholders: Braydon is the first operator and reviewer. Future small-team users and agents need a way to see whether State System is preserving evidence, activation boundaries, qualitative judgment, and cross-app handoffs without reading implementation internals.
prior_attempts: The repo already has schema validation, trace-run, approval-gated traces, context packages, and agent activation records. What was missing was a user-facing test surface and an end-to-end loop plan that keeps pressure tests and integration traces as the build spine.
constraints: Use PlanForge for decomposition and Speedrift/Workgraph for execution.
Do not interview Braydon again; synthesize from existing conversation.
Keep the immediate slice small, local, and testable.
Preserve the model-mediated boundary: models interpret qualitative meaning; code validates refs, schemas, persistence, audit, and rendering.
No live model, database, API, CRM sync, or app rewrite in the first user-testable slice.
out_of_scope: Building Prospecting Partner, Outreach Engine, CRM, Meeting Manager, Thoughtforge, or Visual Forge implementations in this first slice.
Creating direct human state mutation UI.
Turning qualitative judgment into hidden scores, regexes, or deterministic heuristics.
success_criteria: A local command produces a human-readable report for the agent activation trace.
The report shows trace status, steps, activation goal, allowed/prohibited action boundaries, freshness, and captured response status.
The report is generated by the tested trace runner, not a separate hand-authored artifact.
Validation, unit tests, trace-run, and Speedrift drift checks pass.
The Workgraph contains follow-on tasks for stale-context pressure testing and Prospecting -> Outreach -> CRM integration traces.
